steps.name: installed-cli-help
steps.stdout:
usage: zerorun [-h] [--version] [--manifest MANIFEST] [--json]
               {init,authorize,mcp-server,run,explain,list,stats,doctor,pilot-export,observe,cache}
               ...

Conservative deterministic test-result reuse for AI coding agents and CI

positional arguments:
  {init,authorize,mcp-server,run,explain,list,stats,doctor,pilot-export,observe,cache}
    init                install agent integration for the current repository
    authorize           store external per-user authority for exact reviewed
                        configuration
    mcp-server          run the ZeroRun MCP server over stdio
    run                 run or safely replay a configured task
    explain             explain whether a configured task is reusable
    list                list configured tasks
    stats               summarize local execution and reuse events
    doctor              validate the manifest and runtime contract
    pilot-export        write a privacy-preserving aggregate pilot metrics
                        report
    observe             measure an unconfigured command without caching it
    cache               manage the local cache

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --manifest MANIFEST   path to .zerorun.json
  --json                print machine-readable result JSON
